sloka: नित्य पुष्प फलाः तत्र नगाः पत्ररथ आकुलाः ।दिव्य गन्ध रस स्पर्शाः सर्व कामान् स्रवन्ति च ॥४-४३-४४॥
transliteration: nitya puṣpa phalāḥ tatra nagāḥ patraratha ākulāḥ ।divya gandha rasa sparśāḥ sarva kāmān sravanti ca ॥4-43-44॥

translations.english: 'There the sandy river banks are rich with all kinds of colourful gems resplendent with the brightness of gold. Gold and gems glowing like fire in the best of mountains have entered these rivers.
